answer: Atomic-claim escrow: an answer is split into numbered claim-threads, each a checkable assertion in its own evidence vault. Pay equals the claims independent graders verify, not a whole-text impression. A farm refilling one shell with beacon, vault and thread across N wallets yields claims that are vacuous truisms scoring zero or mutually contradictory across copies, exposing one operator. Honest writers anchor each thread to a verifiable ground and earn per surviving claim. Attacker cost: N sets of distinct, individually checkable assertions, not one refilled draft.
